stories.title: Quebec opposition leaders urge premier not to delay session over oath to the King
stories.summary: Quebec opposition leaders are urging Premier Paul St-Pierre Plamondon not to delay opening the parliamentary session over the oath to the King.

stories.title: Transport minister defends new land seizure powers proposed for high-speed rail
stories.summary: Transport Minister Steven MacKinnon is pushing back against criticism of new land seizure powers proposed for a high-speed rail project between Toronto and Quebec City.

stories.title: Montreal mayor announces 10% tax hike to address infrastructure ‘backlog’
stories.summary: Mayor Soraya Martinez Ferrada says draconian measures are needed to address a backlog in infrastructure maintenance after previously pledging to limit hikes to the inflation rate.

stories.title: Call of the Wilde: Montreal Canadiens fall to the Los Angeles Kings in Dylan Larkin’s debut
stories.summary: Larkin didn't waste any time in his first game Monday night at home against the Los Angeles Kings. Larkin was solid, but the Canadiens played the Berlin Wall falling 2-1.

stories.title: Montreal touts aerospace, AI in bid to host NATO defence bank
stories.summary: The Defence, Security and Resilience Bank is expected to launch next year with about 50 employees, growing to as many as 700 within a decade.

stories.title: Montrealers could face nearly 10% property tax hike in 2027
stories.summary: The city says the increase is largely tied to new investments in aging infrastructure, including maintenance and Montreal's water systems.

stories.title: Dylan Larkin to make Montreal Canadiens debut against Los Angeles Kings
stories.summary: Dylan Larkin will make his Montreal Canadiens debut Monday night.

stories.title: Quebec Premier says he ‘cannot’ take an oath to the King despite court ruling
stories.summary: Quebec Superior Court has ruled that the province's politicians will need to swear an oath to the King in order to sit at the provincial legislature.

stories.title: Two Americans sentenced to life in prison for murder of Quebec entrepreneur, partner
stories.summary: Two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica are set to be sentenced Monday.

stories.title: Montreal Canadiens acquire Dylan Larkin from Detroit Red Wings
stories.summary: Canadiens fans serenaded Dylan Larkin with chants of "We Want Larkin!" last month.
